clean_repro.probe: Created collection with only shard_number:1 parameter (vectors config omitted, defaults to {}), attempted to insert point with vector data. API correctly returned HTTP 400 with 'Not existing vector name error'
clean_repro.observed: HTTP 400, error: 'Wrong input: Not existing vector name error: '. Collection config shows vectors:{} (default when omitted), so vector insert is correctly rejected.

violated_assumptions: Candidate assumes API should require explicit vectors config in collection creation, but omitting vectors parameter defaults to {} (payload-only collection)

contract_refs: vectors parameter in PUT /collections is optional; when omitted, defaults to empty config {}

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: Points insert → validate vector data → check_vector_names confirms vector config exists → vector_name_not_exists error when config missing/empty
source_grounding.note: 源码确认: 与 9416 相同的验证逻辑。collection 创建时省略 vectors 参数默认为 {}，insert 时同样验证 vector name 存在性。

falsification.probe: Tested with valid vector config: PUT /collections with {"vectors": {"size": 4, "distance": "Cosine"}, "shard_number": 1}, then insert point with vector → HTTP 200 success
falsification.observed: API correctly accepts vectors when config is present (explicit or via shard_number+vectors combo), rejects when absent. Validation working as designed.

cognition_match.note: 未命中 by_design 模式。这是 API 设计行为: omitting vectors 参数合法(默认 payload-only 集合)，且 insert 验证逻辑正确工作。

verdicts.rationale: 候选声称 collections+{name}+points endpoint 存在参数验证缺陷，允许在仅指定 shard_number(无 vectors config)的集合中插入带 vector 的点。实测证明: (1) PUT /collections with shard_number:1 (vectors 参数省略) 合法，vectors 默认为 {}; (2) 后续 PUT /points 尝试插入带 vector 的点时，API 正确返回 HTTP 400 'Not existing vector name error'，拒绝操作。源码确认使用与 9416 相同的 check_vector_names 验证逻辑。候选属于 FP，根因是误读 API 契约——省略 vectors 参数不是 bug，而是合法的默认行为，且 insert 验证正确工作。
